name: private-attested
sentence: Pays 50 test USDC when check `unit` passes on a merge that only touches src/; funded and paid by the organisation's attestor repository, so nothing public names the private one; refund after 14 days
where: an issue of a private repository the attestor's policy lists

assumes.checks: each named check is a GitHub Actions job (GitHub App 15368) that ran on the default branch's latest commit
assumes.policy: the attestor repository's .knos/policy.yml is: version: 1; private: true; attestor: acme/knos-settle; targets: [acme/vault-core]
